test_title: PYST 16: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F, and G, are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only five people sit between D and F. G sits to the immediate left of F. Only one person sits between G and A. B sits at some place to the left of C but at some place to the right of E.

How many people sit to the right of A?
solution:
Given:

1. There are 7 people facing North. "Only five people sit between D and F" means they must be at the extreme ends.

Possible cases:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3fe5c3788f8bac3df5e22b94b1d1f3fd8642253d0fc03bdfc317693c20095a6.png] 

2. "G sits to the immediate left of F". If F were at the left end, G could not sit to its left. Thus, F is at the right end
